outcome: Intestinal microbiota evolution (alpha diversity, beta diversity, clusters)
Functional capacities of intestinal microbiota (inferred metabolic pathways)
cohort: The study included 596 very preterm neonates from a nationwide birth cohort.
finding: The intestinal microbiota of very preterm neonates matures progressively over time, and preconceptional maternal BMI was identified as the only consistent perinatal factor influencing its development.
mod_finding: Infants born by Cesarean section exhibited a less stable microbiota, frequently shifting clusters.
